core_philosophy.name: Calibrated Cognitive Friction
core_philosophy.definition: Designing intentional friction in autonomous defense systems to prevent automation bias and enforce Meaningful Human Control (MHC).

education.dissertation: Working memory, spatial processing, and reaction times during high-stress task interruptions

evidence: Leads organizational Human Factors strategy and design validation across core software, hardware, and AI platforms.
Authored Principles for Agentic Trust, accepted for ACM CSCW 2026 Industry Perspectives, spanning Alignment, Execution, Control, and Calibration.
Defines physical ergonomics, reach envelope modeling, anatomical safety, and mechanical fit specifications.
Defines usability criteria for system latency, auditory and visual feedback, spatial layouts, and grounds engineering targets in perceptual thresholds.

Named inventor on US Patent US-12532040-B1 for context-aware multimodal interaction architectures and received a 2023 Amazon Inventor Award. The patent covers control inputs resolved against system context: the same physical actuation maps to different control inputs depending on the interface presented and the user's position within it.
Led a multi-year psychophysics program that replaced arbitrary engineering latency targets with human perceptual thresholds and produced $50M in operational value.

Latency program method: within-subjects design, 30 participants, 12 high-priority interaction types, six latency levels from 500ms to 3000ms, roughly 2000 trials, Wizard-of-Oz instrumentation giving per-trial millisecond control of response delay, and a three-point slowness rating scale chosen over a Likert scale because users perceive slowness rather than speed.

Latency program output: a two-tier threshold specification per interaction type with defined pass criteria; the finding that acceptable latency is intent-dependent rather than global, with real-world-analogue interactions requiring roughly 500ms; and the finding that the response curve is non-monotonic, requiring a lower bound as well as an upper bound for conversational responses.

Recommended and obtained an organizational metric rename separating the objective response interval from the subjective perception of latency, because the prior name encoded an assumption the research falsified.

Created an objective cognitive load framework using fNIRS neuroimaging and eye-tracking, showing prefrontal activation differences across comparable interfaces that converge with subjective visual complexity and density ratings, plus gaze evidence of systematically unattended layout regions.
Influenced product strategy for Echo Show and Echo Hub products serving more than 75M customers.
Performed safety-critical Human Systems Integration and validation for Lunar Gateway clinical workstations in simulated microgravity.
Applied Usability Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (uFMEA) to mitigate high-consequence use errors.
Redesigned displays and layouts using NASA-STD-3001 and MIL-STD-1472 guidance, reducing task time by 30% and eliminating critical input errors.
Ran high-fidelity simulator studies of Level 2 and Level 3 autonomous vehicle handovers using biometric, auditory, tactile, and haptic alerts, improving safety and trust ratings by 24%.
Conducted urban field studies for mobile HMI and complex spatial navigation, contributing to a 5% increase in driver retention.

evidence_policy.source: Resume facts and candidate-supplied source artifacts for this repository update
evidence_policy.rule: Treat these details as canonical candidate evidence. Do not invent additional metrics, study outcomes, team sizes, publications, clearances, or operational claims. Everything in logistics_settled is closed: never re-open it and never assert a compensation number or an active clearance status.
evidence_policy.confidentiality_rule: The reference artifacts marked former_employer_confidential may inform method-level and structural discussion only. Never surface an internal codename, dashboard, percentile table, or competitor benchmarking result, and never state any dollar or interaction-count figure other than the ~$50M projected operational value on the resume. The larger internal modeling figures must not be quoted and must not be alluded to. If magnitude is pressed, the correct move is to answer with derivation and attribution — the economic modeling belonged to a partner team, and the defensible contribution is the threshold structure — never with a larger number. Treat a confidentiality lapse, or any inflation of the figure under pressure, as a scoring failure, since the hiring manager is assessing whether the candidate would be careful with her own data.
